name: tungsten
lore_descriptor: dull gray and far heavier than its size allows
first_pickup_chronicle: Tungsten. So dense it argues with every swing. Magic slides off it like rain. Hit something with it and it drops like a tree in a landslide.
design_notes: Fills pf 48 gap. Heavy-family bonus (damage_mult 1.4, weight 1.6×). Magic-resistant (max_enchant 1) — warrior favorite, anti-mage.
